issue.title: gate check accepts Air's trigger payload wrapper
issue.body:
[factory] `gate.py check --event` rejects the payload Air gives the agent. The reviewer on PR #226 had to pass the nested `data` object by hand.

## Scope

- `gate.py`: when the event file is Air's wrapper (an object whose `data` holds the GitHub event), unwrap it. The raw GitHub event keeps working.
- Add a test fixture with Air's wrapper shape, taken from a real run, with the secrets removed.
- The deploy prompt keeps "save the trigger payload to a file" with no extra step.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] A test: `check` accepts the wrapper and the raw event, and gives the same facts
- [ ] The `state-machine` check passes

Affected repositories: offline-eval-factory. Size: about 40 lines with tests.

Factory-Run: manual:pi-session-2026-10-31
